pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with variable edge definitions. On the central flank, patches exhibit sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries, while regions towards the rump and neck show softer, more blurred transitions. Spatial area of patches is highest on the mid-flank, decreasing in size towards the ventral and cervical regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways separating the dark patches. Topological nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the central torso, narrowing significantly towards the lower neck and ventral boundary.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude brush-like silhouette. Individual hair clusters create a jagged geometric contour against the out-of-focus background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least five small avian organisms (oxpeckers) perched along the dorsal mane and upper shoulder. A significant rounded anatomical protrusion is visible on the lower neck/chest junction.
